name: Immune system & fever

primary.label: How hard the immune system is fighting

chart.xLabel: how hard the immune system is fighting

overlay.caption: germs → immune system turns the brain's thermostat up → shiver to heat up

does: Shows the immune system raising the brain's temperature set point while it fights germs
Shows the body shivering to heat up until it reaches the new, higher set point
Shows the gap (and the shivering) shrinking over the first hours
doesnt: Measure any real person — the numbers are illustrative teaching values
Model high or dangerous fevers; it stops at about 101.6 °F
Say anything about what to do for a fever
limits.text: This is a simplified learning model. Real people vary with age, fitness and health. The numbers are illustrative, not measurements of any real person.
limits.wellbeing: A fever that is very high or lasts more than a couple of days is a reason to tell an adult.
